Evan L: Quick ask — CloudPartnerNova requested a focused enablement: packaging Terraform modules for the Cloud Marketplace + ops runbook. 50m session. Who can own slides, demo, and packaging checklist?
Sasha K: I can own marketplace packaging. I'll prepare: manifest example, screenshots checklist, license + support contact, and publishing steps. Keep it short (10m).
Mikhail D: I'll take the Terraform demo + ops runbook. Plan: minimal module that provisions VPC + instance + runtime config. Demo flow: git clone -> terraform init/plan/apply -> smoke verify. I'll also add runbook snippets for upgrades, rollback, and node evacuation.
Evan L: Add a 5m KMS & private deployment note (partners always ask about key handling, rotation, and peering). Also a short SI-integration QA checklist (auth, networking, telemetry).
Sasha K: Noted. I'll include telemetry/lineage metadata fields that marketplace teams need (support_url, telemetry_endpoint, sla_tier). Also will draft an asset manifest (manifest.yaml) example.
Mikhail D: Terraform snippet we'll demo:
```hcl
module "cpnova_refkit" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refkits//cloudpartnernova/terraform/packaging-starter"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
  enable_private_vpc = true
  kms_key_arn = var.kms_key_arn
}
```
Evan L: Can infra create a short-lived sandbox for rehearsal? Request name: cp-nova-pack-2025-09-15, creds TTL 36h. Sasha, Mikhail — can you be added as collaborators?
courtney-bot: Sandbox project created: cp-nova-pack-2025-09-15. Creds TTL: 36h. Rehearsal scheduled: 2025-09-14 17:00 UTC. Repo checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/partner-refkits/cloudpartnernova/enablement-checklist.md
Sasha K: I'll open the packaging PR with manifest example and icon assets by EOD Tue.
Mikhail D: I'll push the packaging-starter module and a tests/smoke/run_smoke.sh script with basic checks (port, model pull auth) by EOD Wed.
Evan L: Owners: Sasha (packaging + marketplace guide), Mikhail (terraform + ops runbook + tests), Evan (coord + slides). Rehearse 24h before. Post PR links here when ready. :rocket:
